title: Behavioral Falsifier
summary: Runs preregistered tests intended to prove components wrong, detect placebo effects, and expose over-caution or stubbornness.
mechanism: Each claim has controls, scoring rules, promotion or retirement criteria, and an adverse-result path. Model behavior is tested separately from code fidelity.
outputs: Held, failed, adverse, or open result
failure_modes: Machine score treated as human judgment
test_status: Multiple screen-grade runs and control arms exist, including adverse outcomes; powered independent replication remains open.
